title: Quantifying biases in LLM-as-Judge evals
authors_zh: Magda Dubois、Harry Coppock、Mario Giulianelli、Ole Kristian Jorgensen、Timo Flesch、Lennart Luettgau、Cozmin Ududec
paper_type_zh: LLM 自动评测偏差的贝叶斯建模与校正研究
best_for_zh: 需要量化 verbosity、自偏好等评测偏差并报告不确定性的研究者。
one_line: Models, quantifies, and corrects systematic biases in LLM autograders.
以贝叶斯广义线性模型识别、量化并校正 LLM 自动评测器的系统偏差。
why: It adds a paper-backed reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: evaluator/reward/verifier reliability, attack, uncertainty, or reward-hacking research.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM autograders are scalable but can favor longer answers or their own model family, confounding capability and risk evaluations. Existing agreement metrics describe disagreement without identifying its source or correcting its effect.

This paper introduces a Bayesian generalized-linear-model framework that estimates autograder bias jointly with the research effect of interest, across absolute scores and pairwise preferences.

LLM 自动评测器可规模化，却可能偏爱更长回答或自身模型家族，使能力与风险评估混入偏差。既有一致性指标只能描述分歧，不能识别来源或校正影响。

论文提出贝叶斯广义线性模型框架，在绝对打分和成对偏好中同时估计自动评测偏差与研究关心的真实效应。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper treats an LLM-judge verdict as a statistical outcome jointly shaped by the compared answers, judge identity, and bias covariates such as verbosity or self-preference. Bayesian generalized linear models estimate the target comparison separately from systematic bias and return uncertainty rather than a single point correction. The fitted model also supports counterfactual simulations: a user can estimate what verdicts would look like with a selected bias removed, without rerunning an expensive judge. The contribution is an analysis and mitigation framework with an accompanying software package, not a new judge dataset.
论文将 LLM judge 的判决视为由被比较回答、judge 身份及偏差协变量共同决定的统计结果；协变量可包括冗长度或自偏好。贝叶斯广义线性模型将目标比较效应与系统偏差分开估计，并输出不确定性，而非只给出一个单点校正值。拟合后的模型还能进行反事实模拟：无需重新调用昂贵 judge，即可估计移除某类偏差后的判决会怎样变化。贡献是带配套软件包的偏差分析与缓解框架，不是新的 judge 数据集。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Specify the target question and potential bias covariates. 2. Fit a Bayesian GLM to absolute or pairwise judge outcomes. 3. Estimate target effects, bias terms, and uncertainty jointly. 4. Simulate counterfactual verdicts with a selected bias removed, then report corrected comparisons. Inputs, priors, judge protocol, and covariates must be fixed; the approach does not itself validate that all biases were measured.
1. 指定目标问题和潜在偏差协变量。2. 对绝对或成对 judge 结果拟合贝叶斯 GLM。3. 联合估计目标效应、偏差项和不确定性。4. 模拟移除某一偏差后的反事实判决并报告校正比较。输入、先验、judge 协议和协变量均须固定；该方法不能保证所有偏差都已被测量。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper demonstrates the framework in simulations, showing that it recovers bias effects and supports counterfactual corrections while providing uncertainty estimates. This supports diagnostic inference under the specified model, not a guarantee that every real judge bias is observed or causally removable.
论文以模拟实验展示框架能恢复偏差效应、支持反事实校正并给出不确定性。这支持在指定模型下做诊断推断，不能保证现实 judge 的每种偏差都被观测或可因果消除。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Unlike agreement-only audits, the method models the target result and bias mechanisms together, then exposes uncertainty and counterfactual mitigation. Its novelty is statistical attribution, not discovering that verbosity or self-preference exists. Inspect covariate selection and model assumptions before treating a correction as valid.
它不同于只报告一致性的审计：同时建模目标结果和偏差机制，再给出不确定性与反事实缓解。新意是统计归因，而非首次发现冗长或自偏好。把校正当作有效结论前，必须检查协变量选择和模型假设。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Bias attribution depends on measured covariates and GLM specification; omitted or correlated sources can be misattributed. Validate with held-out interventions or human labels before acting on a correction.
偏差归因依赖已测协变量和 GLM 设定；遗漏或相关来源可能被错误归因。依据校正行动前，应以留出干预或人工标签验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the package when an autograder informs a model comparison: retain item-level verdicts and candidate/judge covariates, fit the model, then report raw and corrected effects with uncertainty. Do not use it as a substitute for collecting a bias-relevant covariate or human calibration set.
当自动评测器决定模型比较时可使用该软件：保留逐样本判决与候选/judge 协变量，拟合模型并报告原始和校正效应及不确定性。它不能替代收集偏差相关协变量或人工校准集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: 1. Position: Bayesian audit for autograder bias. 2. Lever: joint target/bias GLM. 3. Artifact: software package; institution data is not publicly confirmed. 4. Evidence: simulations support recovery under assumptions. 5. Reuse: disclose covariates and validate corrections.
1. 定位：自动评测偏差的贝叶斯审计。2. 抓手：联合目标/偏差 GLM。3. Artifact：软件包；作者机构未获公开确认。4. 证据：模拟支持假设下的恢复。5. 复用：公开协变量并验证校正。
